name: M Shane Johnson
prior_offices: Lincoln County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed as M. Shane Johnson on the official sheriff page)
background: M. Shane Johnson, also listed as Shane Johnson, is the Lincoln County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official sheriff page lists him in that office. SVI-NEWS reported that the incumbent won the August 2026 Republican primary with 4,057 votes over Val Clement and that the general-election race was then unopposed. The 2022 and 2026 local Profiles are for the same official.
